name: SF-CONFERENCE Form
author: sflabs

sections.description:
The SF-CONFERENCE Form plugin allows you to embed a registration form for your event directly on your WordPress website. Attendee registrations are automatically synced with the SF-CONFERENCE system for efficient event management.

Features:

  • Customizable Forms: Renders form tailored to match your event requirements.
  • Integration: Automatically uploads submissions to your SF-CONFERENCE event management panel.
  • Secure Data: Ensures protection during submissions.

For assistance, contact us at https://www.sf-conference.com.

This plugin connects to the third-party SF-CONFERENCE system, provided by sf-labs sp. z o.o., to display and manage the registration form. During each page load and form submission, data entered into the plugin’s block or the registration form may be transmitted to the SF-CONFERENCE system to render the form or process the submission. For more information on how your data is handled, please review the SF-CONFERENCE system’s Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

Installation and usage

  1. Sign up and create an event at https://www.sf-conference.com.
  2. Download and install the plugin via the WordPress Plugin repository.
  3. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Admin dashboard.
  4. Add the SF-CONFERENCE Form block on a WordPress post or a WordPress page providing the link to the SF-CONFERENCE registration page for your event.
